Faheem Hussain --Petitioner

Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, C. J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Mr. Bhupesh Kandpal and Mr. Abdul Ali, learned 
counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Rahul Verma, learned Addl. Advocate 
General for the State of Uttarakhand/ respondent 
nos.1 to 3.
3. Mr. B.D. Pande, learned counsel for respondent 
no.4.
4. The Executive Officer, Nagar Palika Parishad, 
Ramnagar is directed to file his affidavit and disclose 
the steps taken by the Nagar Palika Parishad to 
establish a slaughter house, which conforms to all 
norms within the limits of Nagar Palika. He will also 
disclose whether any measure was taken by the 
Nagar Palika Parishad to remove the deficiencies 
pointed out by the District Magistrate in his order 
dated 29.11.2025 and also clearly disclose whether 
the existing slaughter house could be made 
compliant with all environmental norms.
5. List as fresh on 22.09.2026.
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.)
